fix_summary: Off-by-one in the retry limit: the guard uses `attempt > MAX_ATTEMPTS` and is evaluated after making the call, allowing one extra call beyond the configured maximum. Correct by enforcing the limit before making the next call (e.g., base the loop on `attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS`) or, with current post-call check semantics, stop when `attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS - 1` so total calls do not exceed MAX_ATTEMPTS.
suggested_test: Create a stub operation that always returns {"ok": false, "status": 500} and count invocations. Verify that call_with_retry invokes it exactly MAX_ATTEMPTS times (not more) and returns after the final attempt.
